name: Sun Pharmaceutical
about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. is a global leader in the pharmaceutical industry, offering a broad portfolio of generic and specialty medicines. The company provides treatments in therapeutic areas such as dermatology, oncology, neurology, cardiology, and ophthalmology. With operations in over 100 countries, Sun Pharma focuses on delivering high-quality, affordable healthcare solutions worldwide. Its commitment to research and development drives innovation in both generic and specialty segments, allowing the company to introduce advanced therapies and improve patient outcomes. Sun Pharma’s extensive manufacturing capabilities and strong global presence make it a trusted partner for healthcare providers and patients across diverse markets.
